s: Which initiative, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during India's 79th Independence Day celebrations in 2025, aims to boost employment generation while improving youth employability and social security?
o: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana

s: Under the Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025, which number of days of work is guaranteed to each household per year?
x: The Act, which came into force on July 1, 2026, replaced MGNREGA, 2005 and increased the guarantee to 125 days per household per year. The tempting answer of 100 days was the earlier guarantee under MGNREGA.

s: Whom does the Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP), a 2016 sub-scheme of DAY-NRLM, mainly support?
o: Custom Hiring Centres for farm machinery
SHG members and their families in setting up non-farm rural enterprises
Placement-linked skill training for rural youth
Interest subvention on crop loans for SHGs
x: SVEP helps SHG members and their families set up non-farm rural enterprises, with community-based loans and convergence with MUDRA.

s: With reference to the daily wages under the VB-G RAM G Act, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: Sikkim has a daily wage of ₹409.
Telangana has a daily wage of ₹308.
Haryana has a daily wage of ₹409.
Andhra Pradesh has a daily wage of ₹312.
x: The incorrect statement is that Sikkim has a daily wage of ₹409; the correct figure for Sikkim’s high-altitude GPs is ₹450, the highest. ₹409 is the daily wage specified for Haryana.

s: In Andhra Pradesh, the VB-G RAM G Mission was initiated from which district?
x: The new Mission was initiated from Tirupati district; MGNREGA was launched in 2006 from Bandlapalli, Anantapur.

s: In the institutional structure of the Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme, what does BRC-EP stand for?
x: BRC-EP stands for Block Resource Centre–Enterprise Promotion. The other options alter either the expansion of BRC or the word “Promotion”.

s: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 was passed in which month and year?
x: The Act was passed in December 2025 and came into force on 1 July 2026.

s: Critics of VB-G RAM G point to a farm-season ‘blackout’ of how many days?
x: Critics cite a 60-day farm-season blackout and exclusion through biometric checks; States bear 40% of wages.

s: Which scheme replaced the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) with effect from 1 July 2026?
x: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 replaced MGNREGA with effect from 1 July 2026.

s: To which index are wages under the VB-G RAM G Act indexed?
x: Wages are indexed to CPI-AL; the Act provides 125 days of work and came into force on 1 July 2026.

s: Nirbhay Chetna was undertaken by which ministry for women’s-safety and gender-equality awareness among approximately 17.5 lakh elected male representatives?
x: Nirbhay Chetna was undertaken by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj. Its target was approximately 17.5 lakh elected male representatives, with 28,500 master trainers.

s: What does Project Ganga in Uttar Pradesh focus on?
x: Project Ganga concerns rural digital connectivity for about 20 lakh families, with 1 lakh+ jobs.

s: The first pilots of Mission Samriddh Gaon, launched by the Ministry of Rural Development, were held in which State?
x: The first pilots were in Budhni Block of Sehore and Khategaon Block of Dewas, Madhya Pradesh.

s: What does Mission Samriddh Gaon aim at?
o: Providing 125 days of guaranteed wage employment
Creating poverty-free villages and curbing distress migration
Universal tap-water connections for rural households
x: Mission Samriddh Gaon aims to create poverty-free villages and curb distress migration.

s: Who implements the Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP)?
x: SVEP is implemented by State Rural Livelihoods Missions; the Quality Council of India did only the mid-term evaluation.

s: In what ratio are wages shared between the Centre and the States under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025?
x: Wage sharing is 60:40, so States bear 40%.

s: For the high-altitude Gram Panchayats of which State is the highest daily wage of ₹450 fixed under the VB-G RAM G Act?
x: Sikkim's high-altitude GPs get ₹450, the highest; Andhra Pradesh gets ₹312.

s: By restructuring which programme was DAY-NRLM launched in June 2011?
x: NRLM restructured SGSY in June 2011 and was renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: For whom is LokOS (Lok Operating System) a digital platform?
x: LokOS is the SHG digital platform under DAY-NRLM.

s: From which village was MGNREGA launched in 2006?
x: MGNREGA was launched in 2006 from Bandlapalli in Anantapur district of Andhra Pradesh.

s: How many days of work per household per year did MGNREGA guarantee?
x: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days; the VB-G RAM G Act raised it to 125 days.

s: What is the daily wage for Andhra Pradesh under the VB-G RAM G Act?
x: AP's daily wage is ₹312 (Telangana ₹308).

s: What is the interim minimum wage floor per day under the VB-G RAM G Act?
x: The interim minimum wage floor is ₹300 a day.

s: With which body is NABARD's Gramodyam pilot, launched on 13 July 2026, training 4,000 rural youth entrepreneurs?
x: NABARD Gramodyam is a 3-year pilot with NSDC to train 4,000 rural youth entrepreneurs.

s: What is the aim of the SAMARTH Panchayat Portal?
o: Paying wages under VB-G RAM G
Raising the Own Source Revenue of PRIs
x: The Atmanirbhar Panchayat / SAMARTH portal aims to raise PRIs' own source revenue by digitising property tax and licences.

s: PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (1 August 2025 – 31 July 2027) aims to create how many jobs?
x: The scheme targets 3.5 crore+ jobs in two years through EPFO.

s: On which date was the e-Shram portal, India's first Aadhaar-authenticated National Database of Unorganised Workers, launched?
x: e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021 and gives each worker a 12-digit UAN.

s: Through which body is the PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana of the Ministry of Labour and Employment implemented?
x: It is implemented through EPFO for 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027.

s: How many schemes are integrated with the e-Shram portal?
x: Fifteen schemes, including PMJJBY, PMSBY and PM Shram Yogi Maandhan, are integrated; the portal supports portability of benefits.

s: For what does the Employer part of the PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana give incentives?
x: The Employer part incentivises additional jobs; the Employee part supports first-time entrants.

s: PM-SETU, approved on 7 July 2026 with ₹60,000 crore over five years, plans to modernise how many ITIs?
x: PM-SETU covers 1,000 ITIs, not 500.

s: Who administers the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026?
o: ESIC under the Ministry of Labour and Employment
PFRDA under the Ministry of Finance
EPFO under the Ministry of Labour and Employment
EPFO under the Ministry of Finance
x: The scheme is administered by the EPFO under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, under the Code on Social Security, 2020.

s: Under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, at least what share of the aggregate fund balance must remain after a partial withdrawal?
x: At least 25% must remain; partial withdrawals fall into three groups and education withdrawals are allowed up to 10 times.

s: Under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, who is ultimately liable for contract workers' PF contributions?
x: The principal employer stays ultimately liable, with deposit due within 15 days of month-end; the contractor is not solely responsible.

s: How many withdrawals for marriage are allowed at most under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026?
x: Marriage allows a maximum of 5 withdrawals; education allows 10.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026?
o: Contribution remains 12% each from employee and employer.
At least 25% of the balance must remain after a partial withdrawal.
International workers may withdraw at 60 years.
x: International workers may withdraw at 58 years (not 60) or as per Social Security Agreements.

s: With which institute is Navachar Mantra, promoting grassroots innovation from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, associated?
x: Navachar Mantra is run by NIESBUD (est. 1983, Noida, under MSDE).

s: What is the outlay of the PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
x: PM-VBRY has an outlay of ₹99,446 crore and targets 3.5 crore jobs.

s: How many registrations had the e-Shram portal crossed by 18 August 2026?
x: e-Shram had 31.89 crore+ registrations, with 15 schemes integrated.

s: The Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 replaces the EPF Scheme of which year?
x: It replaces the EPF Scheme, 1952, under the Code on Social Security, 2020.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Atal Bimit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana:
1. It is run by ESIC and extended to 30 June 2027.
2. It pays 50% of average daily wage for up to 90 days, once in a lifetime.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: the ESIC scheme pays 50% of average daily wage for up to 90 days, once in a lifetime.

s: Which Ministry runs Corporate Mitra, which trains graduates to help MSMEs with compliance, tax and finance?
x: Corporate Mitra is an initiative of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), announced in Budget 2026-27.

s: Who developed the e-Shram portal?
x: e-Shram was developed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment.

s: How many digits does the Universal Account Number (UAN) given under e-Shram have?
x: e-Shram gives a 12-digit UAN.

s: Under which law was the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 notified?
x: The EPF Scheme, 2026 came into force on 29 June 2026 under the Code on Social Security, 2020.

s: Into how many groups were the 13 partial-withdrawal categories merged under the EPF Scheme, 2026?
x: The 13 categories were merged into 3 groups: essential needs, housing needs and special circumstances.

s: From what minimum number of employees does the EPF and MP Act, 1952 apply to an establishment?
x: The EPF and MP Act, 1952 applies to establishments with 20 or more employees.

s: About what share of India's population is covered by social security, with 100 crore+ beneficiaries?
x: Social security covers 100 crore+ beneficiaries, about 64% of the population.

s: What assistance do Custom Hiring Centre projects up to ₹250 lakh get under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization?
x: CHCs get 40% assistance; the 80% assistance up to ₹30 lakh applies to Farm Machinery Banks.

s: Where was Pashujanya Yuddha Abhyas, a five-day zoonotic simulation on Influenza A H1N1, held?
x: Pashujanya Yuddha Abhyas was held at Vidisha in Madhya Pradesh and focused on Influenza A H1N1.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's cooperative sector as reviewed in July 2026?
o: Cooperatives hold the highest share of agricultural credit.
There are more than 8.5 lakh cooperatives.
The Ministry of Cooperation was set up on 6 July 2021.
x: Commercial banks, not cooperatives, hold the highest share of agricultural credit.

s: What is the significance of BIS IS 20201:2026?
o: It is India’s first standard for portable ultrasound cancer screening
It is India’s first standard for e-auctions of oilseeds and pulses
It is India’s first standard for organised-sector employment
It is India’s first standard for Community Seed Banks
x: BIS IS 20201:2026 is India’s first standard for Community Seed Banks. The other options are unrelated to the stated significance of this standard.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Khet Bachao Abhiyan?
o: It was implemented with Gram Panchayats, KVKs and ICAR
It was conducted from 1 to 30 July 2026
It included awareness on KCC and PM-Kisan
It was conducted by the Agriculture and Rural Development ministries
x: The campaign was held from 1 to 30 June 2026, not July.

s: What is the Centre-State funding pattern of the Jal Jeevan Mission?
o: 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States, 50:50 for other States and 100% central for UTs without legislature
60:40 for all States and 100% central for all UTs
75:25 for North-Eastern States and 60:40 for other States
50:50 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and 90:10 for other States
x: JJM funding: NE and Himalayan States 90:10, other States 50:50, UTs without legislature 100% central. 60:40 for all States is a common CSS pattern but not JJM's; 75:25 is not used; option D reverses the two ratios.

s: Bharat Taxi signed an MoU with the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) for integration with which digital platforms?
o: PMJJBY, PMSBY and Skill India Digital Hub
Bharat Pashudhan Portal, MAITRIs and Mobile Veterinary Units
National Career Service, RuPay and DBT
x: The MoU between Bharat Taxi and NeGD covers DigiLocker, UMANG and API Setu. The other combinations refer to welfare, livestock or financial-inclusion services rather than the platforms named in this MoU.

s: What outlay did the Union Cabinet approve for continuing PM-KISAN from 2026–27 to 2030–31?
x: The approved outlay is ₹3.15 lakh crore; the scheme gives ₹6,000 a year in three DBT instalments.

s: What assistance is provided per hectare to small farmers for mechanised services, including drones, under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization?
x: Small farmers receive ₹2,000 per hectare for mechanised services including drones. The other options incorrectly change the basis of assistance from hectare to acre, beneficiary or day.

s: Under the RBI's revised Kisan Credit Card norms from 1 January 2027, agricultural loans up to what limit need no margin money or collateral?
x: The limit is ₹2 lakh; repayment periods are 12 months for short-term and 18 months for long-duration crops.

s: What is the principal objective of Bharati, whose first phase was completed by APEDA?
o: To operate an e-auction platform for oilseeds and pulses
To connect agri-food start-ups with exporters and support the target of USD 50 billion agri exports by 2030
To provide AI-based WhatsApp advice to oilseed farmers
To provide organised-sector jobs through EPFO
x: Bharati connects agri-food start-ups to exporters and is linked with the target of USD 50 billion in agri exports by 2030. The other options describe NAFEX.in, Oilseeds Kisan Mitra and PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana.

s: Up to which year has PM-KISAN, which gives ₹6,000 a year in three instalments, been extended?
x: PM-KISAN was extended to 2030-31; income-tax payers are excluded.

s: When was the National Animal Disease Control Programme launched?
x: NADCP was launched in September 2019; 2024 relates to the Pandemic Fund Project.

s: Which PM-AASHA component pays farmers the gap between MSP and the sale price, without procurement?
x: PDPS pays the gap between MSP and sale price without procuring the produce.

s: In which year was the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) launched under RKVY?
x: SMAM was launched in 2014–15 under RKVY; 2017–18 is when RKVY was restructured as RKVY-RAFTAR.

s: Assam's GI-tagged Muga silk, linked to Mission Senehjori, is produced by which silkworm?
x: Muga silk is produced by the silkworm Antheraea assamensis.

s: At what age are female calves given one-time Brucellosis vaccination under the National Animal Disease Control Programme?
x: Brucellosis (caused by Brucella abortus) vaccination is a one-time dose for female calves aged 4–8 months.

s: Which body recommends the Minimum Support Price?
o: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
x: MSP is recommended by CACP and administered by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

s: Under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization, what share of funds is earmarked for women farmers?
x: 30% of funds are earmarked for women farmers; the NE and Himalayan funding ratio is 90:10.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NAFEX.in?
o: It is an e-auction platform of NAFED
It deals with oilseeds and pulses
Its parent body NAFED was set up on 2 October 1958
It is operated by APEDA for agri-food start-ups
x: NAFEX.in is NAFED's e-auction platform, not operated by APEDA.

s: Which of the following groups is excluded from PM-KISAN benefits?
x: Income-tax payers and most government employees are excluded.

s: Who developed Oilseeds Kisan Mitra, ICAR's WhatsApp AI advisory?
x: Oilseeds Kisan Mitra was developed by IIOR, Hyderabad; it needs no separate app.

s: What is the full form of PM-AASHA?
o: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Agricultural Assistance for Small Holders Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Suraksha Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Agri Assurance Scheme for Harvest Abhiyan
x: PM-AASHA stands for Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan, launched in September 2018.

s: In which year was PM-AASHA launched?
x: PM-AASHA was launched in September 2018.

s: What is the guiding principle of the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)?
x: SMAM works on the principle 'reach the unreached'.

s: In which year was the Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) launched?
x: RKVY began in 2007 and was restructured as RKVY-RAFTAR in 2017-18.

s: In which year was the Kisan Credit Card scheme introduced?
x: KCC has existed since 1998.

s: What toll-free number is used for Mobile Veterinary Units?
x: Mobile Veterinary Units use toll-free number 1962.

s: Which platform was established as India's first cooperative-based ride-hailing platform under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002?
x: Bharat Taxi is India's first cooperative-based ride-hailing platform, set up on 6 June 2025 under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002. Sarathi Didi and Bike Didi are service models associated with Bharat Taxi, while National Cooperative Export Ltd is one of its founding organisations.

s: What are the motto and vision of Bharat Taxi, India's cooperative-based ride-hailing platform?
x: Bharat Taxi’s motto is “Saarthi Hi Maalik” and its vision is “Sahkar se Samriddhi.” The second option reverses the motto and vision, making it incorrect.

s: In Bharat Taxi, what share of earnings is credited as the Sarathis' capital?
x: 80% of earnings is shared by kilometres and 20% is credited as Sarathis' capital.

s: Tribhuvan Sahkari University is India's first what?
x: Tribhuvan Sahkari University is India's first cooperative university, not a bank.

s: What is the vision of the Ministry of Cooperation?
x: The Ministry of Cooperation’s vision is “Sahkar Se Samriddhi,” meaning prosperity through cooperation. “Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas” is not the vision stated for the Ministry of Cooperation.

s: India's cooperative sector, with more than 8.5 lakh units, has about how many members?
x: Cooperatives have about 32 crore members across about 30 sectors, with about 98% rural reach.

s: White Revolution 2.0 aims to raise milk procurement by how much by 2028–29?
x: White Revolution 2.0 targets a 50% rise in milk procurement by 2028–29; 25,282 is the number of dairy societies registered.

s: Who runs Bharat Taxi, India's first cooperative ride-hailing platform?
x: It is run by Sahakar Taxi Cooperative Ltd; NCDC, IFFCO and NAFED are among its eight founders.

s: Which cooperative markets seeds under the 'Bharat Beej' brand?
x: Bharatiya Beej Sahakari Samiti Ltd (BBSSL) uses the Bharat Beej brand.

s: Below what level is the SDG target for maternal mortality ratio by 2030?
x: The SDG target is an MMR below 70 by 2030.

s: Who launched the SUMAN Roadmap-2030 to end preventable maternal and newborn deaths by 2030?
x: The SUMAN Roadmap–2030 was launched by J.P. Nadda.

s: During which period was the sixth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6) conducted?
x: NFHS-6 was conducted during 2023–24 and released by the Union Health Ministry (MoHFW).

s: The e-Pratyaropan national organ donation platform is run by which agency?
x: NOTTO (est. 2014) is the agency; MoS Anupriya Patel launched it on the 16th Indian Organ Donation Day.

s: On which date is World Hepatitis Day observed?
x: World Hepatitis Day is on 28 July; the National Viral Hepatitis Control Program (2018) covers Hepatitis A to E.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyaan?
o: It was launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
It gives free antenatal care on the 9th of every month.
A red sticker on the Mother and Child Protection Card means high risk.
x: PMSMA was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, not WCD.

s: On 8 June 2026, West Bengal became which State/UT to implement Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
x: West Bengal became the 36th State/UT; PM-JAY gives ₹5 lakh per family per year.

s: Where was the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission launched on 1 July 2023?
x: The mission was launched at Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh, on 1 July 2023.

s: Under the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyaan, which gestational-period combination is covered for antenatal care?
o: Third trimester only: 28 weeks until delivery
First trimester: 1–12 weeks, and second trimester: 13–27 weeks
Second trimester: 14–28 weeks, and third trimester: 29 weeks until delivery
Second trimester: 13–27 weeks, and third trimester: 28 weeks until delivery
x: PMSMA covers women in the second trimester from 13–27 weeks and in the third trimester from 28 weeks until delivery. The other options alter the gestational periods or exclude the second trimester.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Garbhini Mitra is a six-month Ayurveda-based maternal-care course
Garbhini Mitra candidates must be senior secondary pass and 18 or above
Srijan: Voices from the Loom was held on National Handloom Day
Srijan: Voices from the Loom was organised by the Ministry of AYUSH
x: Srijan: Voices from the Loom was a Ministry of Textiles event; the Ministry of AYUSH is linked to Garbhini Mitra.

s: In the Unified AMB Abhiyaan Portal, which integrated service holds immunisation records?
x: U-WIN holds immunisation records, JANANI covers pregnant women and RBSK child screening.

s: Which indicator recorded the sharpest rise in NFHS-6?
x: Rotavirus vaccine coverage rose from 36.4% to 85.4%, the sharpest rise; TFR stayed at 2.0.

s: Which of the following changes reported in NFHS-6 is NOT correct?
o: Underweight among under-fives changed from 32.1% to 31.8%
Stunting among under-fives increased from 35.5% to 29.3%
x: Stunting declined, not increased, from 35.5% to 29.3%.

s: Under the PM Surakshit Matritva Abhiyaan, which sticker colour on the Mother and Child Protection Card indicates high risk?
x: A red sticker indicates high risk and a green sticker no risk; screening covers 25 high-risk factors.

s: Which institution was the nodal agency for NFHS-6?
o: International Institute for Population Sciences, Mumbai
x: IIPS, Mumbai was the nodal agency; the Union Health Ministry released the survey.

s: What was India's maternal mortality ratio during 2022-24?
x: MMR fell from 556 (1990) to 130 (2014–16) and 87 (2022–24), a decline of 43 points.

s: By which year does the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission aim to eliminate sickle cell disease?
x: The mission targets elimination by 2047 through screening, diagnosis, genetic counselling and treatment.

s: Within how much time should the birth dose of the Hepatitis B vaccine be given?
x: The Hepatitis B birth dose is given within 24 hours; Hepatitis C has no vaccine.

s: Which hepatitis virus types are monitored through the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme?
x: Hepatitis A and Hepatitis E are monitored through the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme. The other pairs do not match the specified surveillance arrangement.

s: Which supplement does the Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan give as prophylaxis, while also promoting delayed cord clamping?
x: AMB provides prophylactic Iron-Folic Acid, not calcium, and promotes delayed cord clamping.

s:
Assertion (A): Hepatitis D spreads through the faecal-oral route.
Reason (R): Preventing Hepatitis B prevents Hepatitis D.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: The assertion is false because Hepatitis D occurs only in Hepatitis B carriers, rather than spreading through the faecal-oral route. The reason is true: preventing Hepatitis B prevents Hepatitis D.

s: In the revised Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, the earlier T3 framework was expanded to T4 as which of the following?
x: The revised framework changes T3 to T4: Test, Treat, Talk and Track. The other combinations alter one or more of these four components.

s: To which framework did the revised Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan change its 6×6×6 framework?
x: It became 7×7×7 by adding LBW babies aged 0–6 months, Eating Right, and a stronger M&E framework.

s: In which year was the Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan launched under the National Health Mission?
x: AMB was launched in 2018 under the National Health Mission.

s: Below what haemoglobin level are women of reproductive age anaemic as per WHO cut-offs?
x: The cut-off is below 12 g/dL for women of reproductive age and below 11 g/dL for children under 5.

s: To what do the revised Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan guidelines shift the focus from prophylactic supplementation?
o: Universal prophylactic iron supplementation for all age groups
Testing, therapeutic treatment, Eating Right, digital tracking and Jan Chetna/Jan Bhagidari
Food fortification and biannual deworming alone
Iron injections for all pregnant women
x: The revised guidelines, released by the Union Health Ministry, move to testing, therapeutic treatment, Eating Right, digital tracking and Jan Chetna/Jan Bhagidari.

s: To what level did stunting among children under 5 fall from 35.5% as per NFHS-6?
x: Stunting fell from 35.5% (NFHS-5) to 29.3% (NFHS-6).

s: Which institution offers Garbhini Mitra, a six-month Ayurveda maternal-care course?
o: All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi
x: Garbhini Mitra is offered by the All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi.

s: What is the full form of the GHAR portal integrated under Mission Vatsalya?
x: GHAR = Go Home and Re-Unite, integrated with Track Child and Khoya-Paya.

s: On which day of every month is free antenatal care given under the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyaan?
x: PMSMA gives free antenatal care on the 9th of every month.

s: What is India's Total Fertility Rate as per NFHS-6?
x: TFR stays at 2.0 in NFHS-6.

s: As per NFHS-5, what share of children under 5 were anaemic?
x: NFHS-5 found 67.1% of children under 5 anaemic.

s: When is World Sickle Cell Day observed?
x: World Sickle Cell Day is on 19 June.

s: Sickle cell disease is caused by which abnormal haemoglobin?
x: Sickle cell disease is caused by Haemoglobin-S.

s: How many Anganwadi Centres are to be upgraded under Saksham Anganwadi and POSHAN 2.0?
x: 2 lakh AWCs are to be upgraded.

s: In which year was ICDS launched?
x: ICDS began in 1975.

s: Which of the following is true about the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme?
o: The scheme provides financial support only for students in government higher education institutions.
Students with an annual family income of up to 8 lakh are eligible for a 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh.
The scheme is only applicable to students who are pursuing non-technical courses.
Students applying for loan under PM-Vidyalaxmi must provide collateral and a guarantor.

s: According to a NITI Aayog report, about how many government schools closed in India over a decade?
x: About 94,000 government schools closed over a decade, nearly 25 a day; 2.26 crore is the fall in enrolment.

s: In which year was the National Service Scheme (NSS) established?
x: NSS dates to 1969, with the motto 'Not Me But You'.

s: PM Vidyalaxmi offers collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for merit admissions to how many Quality Higher Educational Institutions?
